name: OS-Course Cart Script
observations: The Webflow Open-Studies course-page cart experience (the [OS-Course] IIFE). Previously lived only on the Webflow page; moved into the repo for version control on 2026-06-17.
Editable JS source: src/bvc-app/src/js/os-course/index.js
Editable CSS source: src/bvc-app/src/css/os-course.css (covers BOTH course component AND cart/overlay/notification/spinner/button-state styles)
Generated (git-ignored, rebuilt fresh every build): public/js/os-course.js (~26.9KB) and public/css/os-course.css (~6.6KB)
Loaded from Webflow via <link rel=stylesheet href=https://bvc-uat.vercel.app/css/os-course.css> and <script src=https://bvc-uat.vercel.app/js/os-course.js defer>
Endpoints made config-overridable via window.__OS_COURSE_CONFIG__ = { dataOrigin, apiOrigin }; defaults to UAT origins (data: bvc-uat.vercel.app, api: bvc-uat-api-proxy.vercel.app)

Runtime API calls: POST /api/mstoken (Microsoft OAuth token via proxy), GET /api/bvcpayment?endpoint=...courseofferings/<sku> (seat availability), GET /api/bvcpayment?endpoint=...fee/<skus>/null (fee calc)

Fetches course data from /data/oScourses/course-<sisID>.json (script-expected shape uses a.sections + e.fees.domestic.amount + e.sisId — DIFFERENT from the Next.js page shape which uses course.children)

Webflow migration note: when switching to external <link>+<script src>, REMOVE the old inline <script> and <style id=os-course-styles> blocks so only one copy runs. Use ?v= cache-busting while testing.

name: OS-Course Build Pipeline
observations: esbuild (^0.28.1, dev dependency) bundles+minifies both JS and CSS via src/bvc-app/scripts/build-os-course.mjs
npm scripts (run from src/bvc-app): js:build (one-off minified build), js:watch (rebuild on save), os-course:sandbox (mock server only), os-course:dev (watch + server together)
js:build is wired into the bvc-app build chain: build = 'npm run js:build && npm run bvcapp-scripts && next build'
Generated outputs are git-ignored in src/bvc-app/.gitignore (/public/js/os-course.js and /public/css/os-course.css) so they rebuild fresh on every deploy and never go stale

name: OS-Course Local Sandbox
observations: Local test harness at src/bvc-app/dev/os-course/ (lives OUTSIDE public/ so it is never deployed by the static export)
Run with: npm run os-course:dev (from src/bvc-app) -> opens http://localhost:4321
dev/os-course/server.mjs = zero-dependency Node http server: serves built script (/js/os-course.js), built CSS (/css/os-course.css), mock data (/data/* from dev/os-course/mock/data), and mock APIs
Mock APIs: POST /api/mstoken returns fake token; GET /api/bvcpayment courseofferings returns {seatsAreAvailable:true}; GET /api/bvcpayment fee returns canned fee array
Mock course fixture: dev/os-course/mock/data/oScourses/course-MOCK101.json (in the script's real sections-based shape, since real oScourses files use a different shape)

dev/os-course/dev.mjs spawns esbuild watch + server together; index.html mimics the Webflow page (#courseComponent[data-sisid], os-course-styles, opencartbutton) and sets window.__OS_COURSE_CONFIG__={dataOrigin:'',apiOrigin:''} to hit the local mock server
Documented in OS-COURSE-CART.md at the repo root (moved 2026-06-17 from src/bvc-app/dev/os-course/README.md)

name: sitecore-cloud repo structure
observations: npm workspaces monorepo. Root package.json (name bvc-monorepo, packageManager npm@11.4.1) declares workspaces: [src/nextjs-jamstack, src/bvc-app]. Also src/bvcrendering exists.

Canonical npm install is at the REPO ROOT (installs all workspaces, hoists to root node_modules, maintains single root package-lock.json). Running npm install inside src/bvc-app also works (resolves to workspace root) but is not canonical.

Stray src/bvc-app/package-lock.json was REMOVED on 2026-06-17 (commit 4b42ef8f) — it was redundant in a workspace repo and triggered Next's 'Detected multiple lockfiles' warning. Root lock is authoritative.
Build: at root 'npm run build' = turbo run build (all workspaces); 'npm run build:bvcapp' = turbo run build --filter=bvc-app. turbo.json is at root only.

bvc-app (the marketing site app): output:export static export to out/ dir; bvc-app/package.json build = 'npm run js:build && npm run bvcapp-scripts && next build'; bvc-app/vercel.json buildCommand 'npm run build', outputDirectory 'out', installCommand 'npm install'. This is what Vercel runs for the bvc-app project.
bvc-app/public/data holds generated course data (oScourses, courses, sis-data-lookup.json, osValidCourses.json) produced by the bvcapp-scripts data-generation step.

Cart backend lives in src/nextjs-jamstack: API routes app/api/mstoken/route.ts (MS OAuth client_credentials proxy) and app/api/bvcpayment/route.ts (proxy to extended-edu-registration API). These are the bvc-uat-api-proxy origin the cart calls.
deploy:bvcapp script = 'cd src/bvc-app && vercel --scope=bvc-marketing-its --prod && npm run cleanup' (note: --prod).

name: Windows npm EPERM cleanup warning
observations: On Windows+WAMP, npm install may emit 'npm warn cleanup Failed to remove some directories ... EPERM: operation not permitted, rmdir' (e.g. node_modules/@unrs/resolver-binding-wasm32-wasi/.../@tybys/wasm-util).
It is NON-FATAL — install still completes ('up to date, audited N packages'). Cause: a process holds a file handle in node_modules (running next dev, js:watch, editor indexer, or antivirus).
Fix if it blocks a real update: stop dev servers/watchers, rm the stuck folder, reinstall at repo root. Adding the repo to antivirus exclusions prevents it.
Do NOT run 'npm audit fix --force' to address the pre-existing vulnerabilities — it can do breaking major upgrades (could undo the Next 16.2.6 pin).
